inj.note: With three consecutive DNPs looming, Brown doesn't seem likely to be available Sunday against the Packers. If Brown is ruled out later Friday, the stage would be set for DeMario Douglas, Efton Chism, Kyle Williams and potentially Mack Hollins (calf) -- who has been designated to return from IR -- to handle New England's Week 9 WR duties.

news.h: Patriots rule out A.J. Brown, TreVeyon Henderson vs. Dolphins
news.d: Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins. In addition, No. 2 running back TreVeyon Henderson has been ruled out due to an illness.

news.h: Patriots WR A.J. Brown (ankle, knee) listed as questionable
news.d: Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown is questionable for Sunday's road game against the Dolphins after missing the past two practices due to knee and ankle issues.

news.h: Patriots' A.J. Brown misses practice Thursday due to new knee ailment
news.d: The Patriots' A.J. Brown missed his first practice since returning from IR, with a new knee ailment in addition to his previously injured ankle.
